(b) the direct first-order estimator of FG at tilt +-0.25 on the 27,648-site block (own code; about 4 times the steps of a +-0.5 run), errors by jackknife with class correlations; keep every tilted ensemble inside the liquid (the -1 tilt orders)

the +-0.25 coefficient against 8 Gamma = 1.96 and against the +-0.5 value 1.66 +- 0.19
the probability that H1' is removed

(b) FAITHFUL 96-site block (squares are the only four-cycles, so both face readings coincide; report the four-only and four-plus-six readings side by side as decided): the bound record-partner multiplet with four- AND six-ring trades at their exact context-dependent sizes, built on the local trade clusters (at most 32 states each in the checker's run) inside a symmetry-reduced effective model of at most 256 states; lowest level two-fold or single, signed against unsigned; irrep label under the 8-element group; include a symmetric estimate of the sixth-order corrections to the four-ring trades (0.2 to 1 ferry sizes) as a robustness scan
